title: Polsek Rembang RAG Public Service Assistant
tagline: A public service assistant that answers citizen questions from official SOP documents, helping users understand SKCK, lost report, permit, and police service procedures faster.
taglineId: Asisten layanan publik yang menjawab pertanyaan warga dari dokumen SOP resmi, membantu pengguna memahami prosedur SKCK, laporan kehilangan, izin, dan layanan kepolisian lebih cepat.
seoDescription: I built a RAG public service assistant that answers police service questions from official SOP documents with clear guidance.
features: Interactive chat for Q&A about police services with a friendly yet professional and informative tone.

LangChain-based RAG over SOP documents: answers are derived from administrative service documents such as station profile, service hours, SKCK, lost item reports, event permits, detainee visits, and related public-service procedures.
Response guardrails: assistant only answers topics relevant to police services, and politely declines off-topic questions.
Consistent answer format (plain text): no markdown, no unusual symbols - easily readable on any device.
Quick actions to speed up user flow: e.g., police service buttons, incident reports, and contact an officer.
Download transcript: users can download chat history as evidence/conversation summary.
featuresId: Chat interaktif untuk tanya-jawab seputar layanan kepolisian dengan nada ramah namun tetap profesional dan informatif.

RAG berbasis LangChain atas dokumen SOP: jawaban diturunkan dari dokumen layanan administratif seperti profil kantor, jam layanan, SKCK, laporan barang hilang, izin acara, kunjungan tahanan, dan prosedur layanan publik terkait.
Guardrail respons: asisten hanya menjawab topik yang relevan dengan layanan kepolisian, dan menolak dengan sopan pertanyaan di luar topik.
Format jawaban konsisten (plain text): tanpa markdown, tanpa simbol tidak biasa - mudah dibaca di perangkat apa pun.
Quick action untuk mempercepat alur pengguna: misalnya tombol layanan kepolisian, laporan insiden, dan hubungi petugas.
Unduh transkrip: pengguna dapat mengunduh riwayat chat sebagai bukti/ringkasan percakapan.
impact: Speeds up access to service information: citizens no longer need to search for procedures and requirements as answers are instantly available via chat.
Reduces repetitive questions to officers for administrative matters (SKCK, lost items, permits), allowing officers to focus on field services.
Enhances citizen experience with clear, consistent, and human-like responses - bringing public services closer through AI technology.
impactId: Mempercepat akses informasi layanan: warga tidak perlu lagi mencari prosedur dan persyaratan karena jawaban langsung tersedia via chat.
Mengurangi pertanyaan berulang ke petugas untuk urusan administratif (SKCK, barang hilang, izin), sehingga petugas bisa fokus pada layanan lapangan.
Meningkatkan pengalaman warga dengan respons yang jelas, konsisten, dan manusiawi - mendekatkan layanan publik lewat teknologi AI.
